boundary.description: From the point where Borsdane Brook crosses Dicconson Lane, S along the Brook, including Mill Lane and Millbrook Close in the Holy Family parish. Then along the diocesan boundary to the point where it crosses New Road, and by a bee-line SE to and E along Wigan Road, Bolton Road to its junction with Hall Lane, by a bee-line to Borsdane Brook and by that brook to the point where it crosses Dicconson Lane.
